items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Freddie Green in the context of Basie's band, and the interviewee (Gene Ramey) responds to the interviewer's statement about bop eliminating guitar players, but does not explicitly state a personal or professional relationship with Freddie Green himself.

ctx.x: They learned how to stay out of each other's way there. There was no problem at all there for the Basie would stay out of the way of the guitar. Now if you'll notice--
That's a very interesting part point because what he was doing there was what he more-or-less does later when he gets rid of Page--
